pcs.pc_description: identify and segregate reeling quality cocoons from the given lot
weigh the segregated cocoons and record their weight
transfer segregated cocoons to the drying area as per SOP
store the cocoons in the specified area as per prescribed method
draw samples from segregated lot for reelability test
undertake reelability test as per the standard operating procedure
collect the reelability parameters for cocoon sorting & mixing (viz – filament length, non-breakable filament length, filament weight, waste, denier, etc.)
carryout cocoon mixing as per the silk quality requirement

gs: GS2. read and comprehend written cocoon drying instructions

pcs.pc_description: accumulate the cocoons in trays and assemble them in trolley
pre heat the drying machine as per the quality requirement
verify the condition of the running of fans inside the drier as per drying requirement
place the cocoon tray inside the drier and set prescribed temperature for drying
assess the degree of dryness as per standard testing method
store the dried cocoons in the specified area as per SOP
maintain prescribed temperature, humidity condition inside the storage area using prescribed tools
